scenarios.label: Humid • Rain likely
scenarios.tip: Rain is likely. Recheck irrigation and inspect lower foliage.

scenarios.label: Warm • Mostly dry
scenarios.tip: Warm conditions can raise crop water demand. Check root-zone moisture.

scenarios.label: Mild • Stable
scenarios.tip: Conditions are stable. Continue the planned field round.

scenarios.label: Wet spell
scenarios.tip: Avoid unnecessary irrigation and inspect for waterlogging or disease symptoms.
